description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company as its first engineering hire, working directly with the founder. You will turn a functioning product into scalable infrastructure for AI-powered service businesses, with the opportunity to grow into a CTO role as the company develops.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build scalable agentic infrastructure to support substantial growth in users and workloads.

 - Design and operate the agent runtime, including orchestration, memory, and systems for verification.

 - Own engineering work end to end across backend, infrastructure, frontend, and AI agents.

 - Set the architecture, technology choices, and engineering practices.

 - Ship improvements regularly to customers running real businesses on the product.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2 years of production software experience, or an equivalent record of building and shipping real systems as a founder, solo builder, or exceptional early-career engineer.

 - Experience building and operating LLM or AI agent systems used by real customers in production.

 - Full-stack range, with the ability to take work from backend and infrastructure through to the user interface.

 - Experience scaling a working product, including architecture, data models, runtime, or orchestration.

 - Technical ownership in a founder, early-hire, or solo-lead role, with a track record of frequent production releases.

 - Agent orchestration, memory, evaluation, verification, or multi-agent workflow experience is valuable; experience in recruiting, agencies, or service delivery is also relevant.

 - Based in Europe and open to relocating to San Francisco within the first year.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is €80,000 to €140,000 annually. Equity is available. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for a move to San Francisco.


LOCATION

Remote in Europe, with relocation to San Francisco expected within the first year.
